evidence.Medial Meniscus: undisplaced degenerative type tear through the corresponding posterior horn and root
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Mildly degenerate but otherwise intact lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Mild age-related thinning of tricompartmental articular cartilage, probably most apparent at the medial weightbearing compartment
evidence.Lateral OA: Small focus of grade 3 cartilage loss noted at the central portion of the lateral tibial plateau
evidence.PF OA: Tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss with associated faint focal reactive marrow changes is noted adjacent to the median ridge of the patella
evidence.Effusion: minimal intra-articular fluid, probably within normal physiological limits
evidence.Contusion: faint focal reactive marrow changes is noted adjacent to the median ridge of the patella
